title: Hydra Brothers
summary_html: The Hydra Brothers are a three-headed beast which guards the Caddellite meteorite on Ambrosia. While being in possession of a singular body, the monster's three heads each bears a distinct personality and will talk amongst themselves, referring to one another as "brother." They each bear a name: Shandu, Shanda and Shando.
